profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and trades under the ticker TSM. On its own site the company describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987, saying it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions. The site also presents TSMC's business model as a driver of innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and describes the company's contribution to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The site material does not name specific AI products or services. Its stated position is as a foundry and design enablement provider for the semiconductor industry rather than as a vendor of AI applications, and no AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company. No lawsuits are listed either. The company's SEC filing identity is recorded as CIK 0001046179.
